description: This file defines an abstract class for implementing request-response endpoints in an AMQP-based service. It manages link handling, message processing, authorization checks, and response forwarding, serving as a base class for specific endpoint implementations like device registration or credentials APIs.

classes.name: RequestResponseEndpoint
classes.description: Abstract base class for AMQP request-response pattern endpoints, handling link setup, message processing, authorization, and response management.

methods.name: getEventBusServiceAddress
methods.description: Returns the event bus address for service invocation requests.

methods.name: createEventBusRequestMessage
methods.description: Constructs the event bus message for invoking a service operation.

methods.name: getAmqpReply
methods.description: Creates an AMQP message representing a service response.

methods.name: getAuthorizationService
methods.description: Retrieves the current authorization service used for access control.

methods.name: setAuthorizationService
methods.description: Sets the authorization service; defaults to ClaimsBasedAuthorizationService if not provided.

methods.name: onLinkAttach (ProtonConnection, ProtonReceiver, ResourceIdentifier)
methods.description: Handles incoming link attachments for request messages, setting QoS and flow controls.

methods.name: handleRequestMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming request messages, including verification, authorization, request forwarding, and response sending.

methods.name: getServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Converts various exceptions into a standardized ServiceInvocationException.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if the client is authorized to perform the requested operation; default delegates to authorizationService.

methods.name: extractResponse
methods.description: Extracts an EventBusMessage from an event bus reply.

methods.name: filterResponse
methods.description: Applies optional filtering to responses before sending; default passes responses through.

methods.name: onLinkAttach (ProtonConnection, ProtonSender, ResourceIdentifier)
methods.description: Handles establishment of response sender links for reply-to addresses, validating addresses and managing sender mappings.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Cleans up sender mappings when an AMQP connection is closed.

methods.name: getSenderForConnection
methods.description: Retrieves an active ProtonSender for a given connection and reply-to address.

methods.name: registerSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Associates a ProtonSender with a reply-to address.

methods.name: unregisterSenderForReplyTo
methods.description: Removes the sender association for a reply-to address.

methods.name: deallocateAllSendersForConnection
methods.description: Removes all sender mappings for a specific connection.

methods.name: flowCreditToRequestor
methods.description: Replenishes message credits on a receiver link.

methods.name: isValidReplyToAddress
methods.description: Validates the format of a reply-to address, default requiring at least three path segments.
